title: Table of every eccentric micropolar row
status: final (rc2 runs); incomplete: rows at g = 200 dx and the noise floors still running
caption: Every micropolar run between eccentric cylinders (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, rotor axis displaced by eps g, w = 0 on both walls, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf) against its Newtonian control on the same particles. D_T = T / T_control - 1 by four readings (rotor and stator; wall form = pair sums over the wall particles, circle form = flux of angular momentum across a circle at distance h from the wall); 'corrected' = their mean with the error each reading makes between concentric cylinders at the same K, l and g taken off ('-' where that concentric row does not exist). Predictions: the film function of micropolar lubrication theory in the thin-film calculation (load: plane film; torque: shear-driven stress of the exact concentric solution at the local gap) and the wall rule on the exact Stokes solution of its slip-form geometry. 16 rows (12 on the lattice as generated). Load change over the film function 0.971 to 1.011, over the rule 0.374 to 0.928; torque change over the film function 0.953 to 0.991, over the rule 0.538 to 0.984. Noise floor of the changes from three lattices (max - min): e30: D_T 0.0007, load change 0.04 points, turn 0.00 degrees; e60: D_T 0.0003, load change 0.04 points, turn 0.01 degrees. Stage 6 runs on thesis-ch5-rc2 (numerics.delta_fluid_only: true).
